2800: the same as חֲרֹשֶׁת; Charosheth, a place in Palestine; Harosheth.

2805: from חָשַׁב; a belt or strap (as being interlaced); curious girdle.
2806: from חָשַׁב and דִּין; considerate judge; Chasbaddanah, an Israelite; Hasbadana.
2807: from חָשַׁב; estimation; Cashubah, an Israelite; Hashubah.
2808: from חָשַׁב; properly, contrivance; by implication, intelligence; account, device, reason.

2813: from חֶשְׁבּוֹן and יָהּ; thought of Jah; Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites; Hashabniah.

2831: from an unused root (probably meaning firm or capacious in resources); apparently; wealthy; princes.
2832: feminine of חַשְׁמַן; fertile; Chasmonah, a place in the Desert; Hashmonah.

2845: from חָתַת; terror; Cheth, an aboriginal Canaanite; Heth.

2857: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to חָתַם; to seal; seal.

2879: feminine of טַבָּח; a female cook; cook.

2888: of uncertain derivation; Tabbath, a place East of the Jordan; Tabbath.
